description: checks a URL effective port against a caller allowlist using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded url port policy check result before accepting, caching, redirecting, or retrying a caller-supplied web response. Returns normalized web evidence, the computed finding, and an explicit pass or advisory status for URL Port Policy Check as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Evaluates only caller-supplied metadata; it performs no DNS lookup, HTTP request, web search, credential use, or persistent storage.

allowed_ports.description: Allowed Ports supplied to URL Port Policy Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

url.description: URL supplied to URL Port Policy Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_url_port_policy_check
